meta.name: convex-quickstart
meta.description: Get a barebones Convex + web template running from a one-sentence idea.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一句话创意变成可运行的网站模板
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果...想用一句话快速生成可运行的全栈项目
copy.tagline_en: Turn a one-line idea into a runnable web template
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to spin up a runnable web project from a single idea

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能根据你的一句话想法,在本地生成一个极简的 Next.js + Convex 模板项目,自动安装依赖、启动后台和网页开发服务器并打开网址;在动手添加模板之外的功能前,会先给出简短计划并等你确认。
howto.when: 当你说出一句话的项目想法,要求基于 Convex 搭一个可运行的网页模板时触发;典型说法如“用 Convex 起个模板”“帮我从一句话想法跑起来”等。

say.text: 用 Convex 把我的‘一个待办列表网站’跑起来
say.note: Claude 会生成模板并启动开发服务器。

say.text: 用 Convex 快速搭一个 Next.js 模板,想法是‘每日一句名言’
say.note: 会创建项目并打开本地网址。

say.text: 基于 Convex 起一个最小可运行的项目,想法是‘共享剪贴板’
say.note: 先展示计划,确认后再扩展。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can take a one-sentence idea and spin up a barebones Next.js + Convex template locally, installing dependencies and starting the backend and web dev server, then open the URL. It will present a short plan and ask for confirmation before building extra features.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you give a one-sentence idea and ask to get a runnable Convex + web template, e.g. "spin up a Convex template" or "run it from a one-liner idea."

say_en.text: Get a to-do list site running with Convex
say_en.note: Creates the template and starts the dev server.

say_en.text: Quickly scaffold a Next.js Convex template for 'daily quote'
say_en.note: Creates the project and opens the local URL.

say_en.text: Stand up a minimal Convex project for 'shared clipboard'
say_en.note: Shows a plan first; waits for confirmation.
